extension.summary: No scrolling. No deciding. Just watching.
extension.description: Tired of scrolling through your library wondering what to watch? EasyTV handles it. It tracks your shows and always knows your next episode. When you're ready for something new, it'll suggest a show you haven't started. Throw in some movies if you want. Just sit down, press play, and enjoy. Built for Kodi 21+.
extension.news: v1.7.0 (2026-08-30) - New "Surprise Me" button in every browse view: picks a show for you and starts its next episode - Fixed episodes added to a show later going missing from that show's list on synced devices - Fixed a negative "Skipped" count in the browse list - Fixed an in-progress episode not showing its progress on your other devices - Fixed part-watched premieres of the wrong type appearing in premieres-only lists - Faster sync: no longer repeats smart playlist work for shows that did not change
